summary: Globavend Holdings Ltd reported on Form 6-K that controlling shareholder Wai Yiu Yau sold all 100 management shares and 57,224 ordinary shares (2.4% of shares, 97.7% of voting power) to Central Master Enterprises Ltd, owned by CFO Tsz Ngo Yu and subsidiary director Kai Man Fung. Concurrently, Mr. Yau stepped down as chairman but remains CEO; Mr. Fung became chairman, Mr. Yu director, and Mr. Tsui independent director. Mr. Cheung resigned as independent director. The change of control triggers board/management restructuring, effective April 29-30, 2026. Watch for operational stability and potential strategic shifts under new control.
